definition: someone from before I have thought about contacting again

settled:
In Nauvoo I read an apostle's article saying missionaries should leave with no entanglements, girlfriends included. That night I called Kerry from the phone in the hall and broke up with her.

It was one of the most painful conversations of my life, and she did not understand at all.

Neither of us has communicated with the other since that night.

I have thought about reaching out a few times more recently, as I have felt the desire for connection more in my life.
